text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 36 vials of plerixafor 24 mg/1.2 mL, providing 8.4 days on hand at a daily use of 4.3 vials. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC is discontinuing manufacture.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include plerixafor as of 2026-10-21. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC is listed with status To Be Discontinued, with an initial posting date of 2026-03-13 and a business decision to discontinue manufacture.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately one week. Multiple alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list and have available supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer to place orders with Gland Pharma Limited — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
3. Buyer to place orders with Novadoz Pharmaceuticals LLC — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
4. Buyer to place orders with Sagent Pharmaceuticals — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
5. Buyer to place orders with Sanofi-Aventis U.S. LLC — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Approval: Pharmacy Director.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until stock is depleted.
